title: Tabibe {version} — Your personal new-tab workspace
description: Make your new tab a home for shortcuts, folders and notes. Explore Tabibe {version}, download the extension and learn how your data stays local.
heroDescription: Tabibe transforms every new tab into a personal productivity space with shortcuts, folders, notes and the search engine you choose.
downloadNote: GitHub download · Install manually in Chrome. A Chrome Web Store listing is not available yet.
featuresDescription: The everyday tools you need, together in your new tab.

features.title: Time & Date Widget
features.description: Keep time and date at a glance, or hide the clock from Settings.

features.title: Speed Dial Grid
features.description: Reach saved sites quickly, organize folders and choose local brand or optional Chrome site icons.

features.title: Your Search Engines
features.description: Use Chrome’s default provider or explicitly choose Google, Bing, DuckDuckGo or Yandex.

features.title: Notes & Quick Capture
features.description: Capture an idea, then organize it with notebooks, tags, search, pins and archives. Preview Markdown and see local save status.

features.title: Drag & Drop Layout
features.description: Reorder sites and move them into or out of folders. Keyboard actions are available too.

features.title: Light & Dark Theme
features.description: Switch appearance and use matching background colors for a consistent workspace.

features.title: Background Customization
features.description: Choose a solid color or an image from your device to personalize the page.

features.title: Data Backup
features.description: Export a local JSON backup and preview it before restoring. Keep a separate copy of important notes.

features.title: 13 Languages
features.description: Choose your interface language in Settings. The bundled privacy policy is also available offline in all 13 languages.

languagesDescription: Available in 13 interface languages, with right-to-left Arabic support.
installDescription: Download Tabibe {version} from GitHub and make your new tab your own.

installSteps.title: Download and extract
installSteps.description: Get tabibe-v{version}.zip from this release and extract it to a folder you can keep.

installSteps.title: Open Chrome extensions
installSteps.description: Paste the address below into Chrome’s address bar, then enable Developer mode.

installSteps.title: Load your folder
installSteps.description: Choose Load unpacked and select the extracted folder containing manifest.json. Open a new tab to use Tabibe.

copied: Address copied. Paste it into Chrome’s address bar.
copyError: Copy was unavailable. Select and copy the address manually.
updateNote: Updating an unpacked installation? Export a backup first, replace files in the same extension folder and click Reload in chrome://extensions. Keep that folder in place.

faq.question: Does Tabibe change my search engine?
faq.answer: No. The first search option follows Chrome’s existing default through Chrome Search API. You can explicitly select another provider in Tabibe. Older unversioned Tabibe search preferences move once to the browser default.

faq.question: Where are my notes stored?
faq.answer: Notes, shortcuts, settings and background images stay in the local browser profile. Tabibe does not encrypt that storage or exported JSON files. Avoid sensitive information and protect your device and backups. The developer cannot recover your local data remotely.

faq.question: What happens when I remove the extension?
faq.answer: Removing Tabibe removes its local extension data, including local recovery copies. Export a backup first if you want to keep your workspace. Previously exported files and device backups need to be managed separately.

faq.question: Can I use Tabibe offline?
faq.answer: The new-tab page, notes, bundled icons and privacy policy work offline. Web searches and the websites you open need a connection and follow the destination service’s policies.
